ruleOverrides.linePrefix: If a leader or support model in an attached unit is destroyed and subsequently revived,
ruleOverrides.currentLine: If a leader or support model in an attached unit is destroyed and subsequently revived, it returns on its own as a unit of one, rather than returning as part of its attached unit.
ruleOverrides.sourceLocator: article, revival of an attached Leader or Support model
ruleOverrides.overrides: Older attached-unit return semantics in the secondary digital snapshot

ruleOverrides.linePrefix: You can only generate a single extra CP per battle round.
ruleOverrides.currentLine: You can only generate a single extra CP per battle round.
ruleOverrides.overrides: Older secondary snapshot without the additional CP cap
Former Grenade Stratagem references resolve to the Explosives identity; Core Stratagem text is unchanged

ruleOverrides.sourceLocator: article, Crushing Impact formerly Tank Shock

ruleOverrides.linePrefix: In your Shooting phase, enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE units that are engaged can be selected as targets of ranged attacks.
ruleOverrides.currentLine: In your Shooting phase, enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE units that are engaged can be selected as targets of ranged attacks (excluding attacks made with [BLAST] weapons).
ruleOverrides.overrides: Original main-rule sentence omits the Blast exception already confirmed by the GW launch FAQ

universalRulesUpdates.title: Modifying a Stratagem's CP Cost
universalRulesUpdates.text: If a rule lets you target a friendly unit with an unnamed Stratagem for 0CP, it instead reduces the CP cost of that use by 1CP.
universalRulesUpdates.sourceLocator: page 1, Modifying a Stratagem's CP Cost

universalRulesUpdates.title: Stratagems That Can Be Used More Than Once per Phase or Turn
universalRulesUpdates.text: Parts of a rule permitting a Stratagem to be used after another unit was targeted with it in the same phase apply only if that rule explicitly names the Stratagem. The same requirement applies to bypassing a Stratagem's one-use-per-player limit per turn, battle round or battle.
universalRulesUpdates.sourceLocator: page 1, Stratagems That Can Be Used More Than Once per Phase/Turn

universalRulesUpdates.title: Stratagems That Prevent Units from Being Targeted
universalRulesUpdates.text: If a Stratagem prevents ranged attacks against its target unless the attacking model is within 12 inches, that distance becomes 18 inches for either form of this restriction specified in the official update.
universalRulesUpdates.sourceLocator: page 1, Stratagems That Prevent Units from Being Targeted

universalRulesUpdates.title: Stratagems That Add New Units to Your Army
universalRulesUpdates.text: A Stratagem that adds a new unit identical to one of your destroyed units gains a once-per-battle use restriction.
universalRulesUpdates.sourceLocator: page 1, Stratagems That Add New Units to Your Army
universalRulesUpdates.overrides: Unrestricted repeated use of qualifying unit-replacement Stratagems

universalRulesUpdates.title: Move Types for Disembarking Units
universalRulesUpdates.text: If a rule allows a unit to declare a charge after disembarking from a TRANSPORT that made a normal move that turn, the unit makes an assault disembark move instead of a disembark move. If a rule allows a unit to disembark from a TRANSPORT that made an advance move that turn, the unit makes a shock disembark move instead of a disembark move.
universalRulesUpdates.sourceLocator: page 1, Move Types for Disembarking Units
universalRulesUpdates.overrides: Disembark move type for the two specified Transport permissions
